findings.title: Fallback locale files are not loaded outside controller requests
findings.body: The accelerator only lazy-loads `config.locale`. `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` then performs fallback lookups directly against the backend, so it does not re-enter this method to load the site-default or English locale files. The new preload in `ApplicationController#set_locale` masks this for normal web requests, but mailers, background jobs, rake tasks, and other non-controller code bypass that filter. In a cold worker using (for example) `:fr`, a missing French key will still be missing even if it exists in the default or English YAML because only `fr` was loaded. Load the entire fallback chain as part of translation/lazy loading rather than relying on a controller callback.

findings.title: Changing the site default locale leaves cached fallback translations stale
findings.body: The fallback chain is computed dynamically from `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but optionless translations are cached by the accelerator using only the key, current locale, and backend object. For example, a missing `:fr` key can be resolved from English and cached; after an administrator changes the site default locale to German, subsequent `:fr` lookups hit that cached English value instead of following the new fallback order until `I18n.reload!` happens. Include the effective fallback/default locale in the cache key or explicitly clear the translation cache when `default_locale` changes.
